coachAM: Your gratitude for opportunities and relationships is commendable, but the fragmented morning entries, riddled with distractions like "Instagram, games, loop scrolling," reveal a severe lack of intentionality and self-governance before the day even begins, directly sabotaging your sleep and training protocols. The root cause is a catastrophic failure in establishing internal control over your attention and impulses, which metastasizes into physical and executive discipline breakdowns, ultimately eroding your capacity to operate with the sustained focus and resilience required at an elite level. Immediately delete all social media apps from your phone and move it out of your bedroom for the next 7 days, replacing that void with a physical book for your "Sovereign Morning" slot.
